title: EditJobRequestV1

profile_id.description: Profile whose model predicts the edits. Without it the look comes only from the selection's edited photos.

format_type.description: Only without profile_id: how to read the photos' white balance.

straighten.description: Level photos with clear reference lines; the result then carries Lightroom crop keys.

learn_from_edits.description: Photos among photo_ids that the photographer already edited (their develop settings differ from the selection's untouched state) set the shoot's look. They are examples only and get no result.
